uncertainties: Rikuto and Kilsres provisional names pending root research. Kyuuma explicitly calls the rebel summoner male in preceding context.
text:
that's how it was...
So...
that's how it was...
Among his colleagues
in the faction, he stood out
in both mind and body.
This island was once barren.
It became what it is today
only through his tireless efforts...
That is why he could not accept
the decision to dispose of
the island and all of us with it.
So that led to the battle...
Faced with unexpected resistance,
the faction deployed
that magical sword as its trump card.
The Swords of Sealing...
Shartos, the Azure Sage Emperor,
and Kilsres, the Crimson Tyrant.
The two swords' sealing power
robbed him of his magic.
His defeat decided the battle.
But Lord Rikuto fought
to the very end to let us escape...
He fought with everything he had...
...
Thanks to their final stand,
the faction withdrew
from the island.
That is why
we are still
alive today.
To think this sword
was created for
such a purpose...
The sword's power
that you wield is part of
the power sealed away that day.
So if you master the sword further,
you should be able to restore
the ruins' functions.
Then I could finally
fulfill my lord's
dying wish...
...
I want my family...
my unborn child, to see
the landscapes of Silturn...
...!!
To fulfill that wish,
I have endured
the shame of surviving.
So that's why
you encouraged me
to use the sword...
So that's why
you encouraged me
to use the sword...
...
All this time,
he's lived with
that single wish...
All this time,
he's lived with
that single wish...
That's why...
he's been
so desperate...
Kyu...
Don't move!!
!?
Hiding your presence
won't fool a shinobi!
Give up and show yourself!
...!?
G-aaaargh!?
Kyuuma!?
Kyuuma!?
Ghh...!
Waaaah!?
